ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scam: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future scam, where an alleged fraudster has been on the run since 2022 and was recently added to the FBI's most wanted list
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail and identify key players involved in the scam
questions: Who are the key players involved?
What were the methods used to carry out the scam?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and potentially lead to the capture of the alleged fraudster
